1:1.note: Plus 'on the first of the month' (cf. date formula).

1:4.note: Particle נא not rendered; Ketiv/Qere ומעליליכם both mapped.

1:5.note: Word order changed: 'where are they, your fathers'.

1:6.note: Interrogative הלוא not rendered; השיגו rendered 'remembered' with plus pronoun.

1:7.note: Second חדש not rendered; number order four-and-twenty.

1:8.note: והנה not rendered; myrtles rendered 'trees' and במצלה read as 'which shade'.

1:11.note: ויאמרו moved forward; והנה not rendered.

1:15.note: השאננים rendered 'who rage'; אשר rendered by 'for'.

2:2.note: Plus copula pronouns and vocative 'my lord'.

2:4.note: לאמר rendered 'to me'; לידות read as 'uproot'.

2:6.note: Plus 'to him'; length and breadth transposed.

2:7.note: והנה not rendered; verb moved first.

2:8.note: לאמר not rendered; 'sons of men' for אדם.

2:9.note: Plus 'like'; סביב not rendered; 'in her midst' replaces לה.

2:12.note: Plus pronoun; second 'touches' moved to end.

2:15.note: 'to him' for MT 'to me'; 'he will dwell' for 'I will dwell'.

3:2.note: 'The angel of the LORD' speaks instead of the LORD.

3:4.note: Command 'remove the filthy garments' doubled (plus); 'good garments' for מחלצות.

3:5.note: Plus 'good' garments; 'and he said' for 'and I said'.

3:7.note: וגם particles and second אם not rendered.

3:8.note: נא not rendered; 'you are' for 'they are'; צמח rendered 'Dawn'.

3:9.note: פתחה read as 'its doors'; 'that day' for 'one day'.

4:2.note: כלה and והנה not rendered; Ketiv/Qere ויאמר/ואמר both mapped.

4:4.note: לאמר not rendered; plus copula pronoun.

4:6.note: ויען and both לאמר not rendered; plus 'to me'.

4:10.note: Word order of 'these seven eyes' changed.

4:13.note: לאמר and interrogative ה not rendered.

5:2.note: Syriac reads 'ten' cubits length for MT 'twenty'.

5:5.note: נא not rendered; plus copula pronoun.

5:6.note: Second ויאמר not rendered; 'their eye' read as 'their sins' (עונם).

5:8.note: Plus 'to me' and copula; רשעה rendered 'sin'.

6:3.note: ברדים אמצים rendered by one word 'piebald'.

6:5.note: יוצאות not rendered; plus copula pronoun.

6:10.note: Pronoun אתה not rendered; Heldai = Huldai.

6:12.note: לאמר twice not rendered; 'and he shall build the temple' (MT 12b) not rendered here.

6:14.note: Helem rendered Huldai and Hen rendered Josiah.

7:1.note: Plus relative 'which is' before month name Kanun.

7:2.note: Regem-melech split as 'Rabmag and sent the king'.

7:6.note: Second 'you' and 'drink' combined; interrogative rendered negative statement.

7:7.note: Question rendered as 'these are the words'; Negev rendered 'mountains'.

7:10.note: Sojourner as 'him who turns to me'; plus 'and do not oppress'.

7:13.note: 'I called' for 'he called'; plus object pronouns.

7:14.note: Plus 'without' and 'because'; free rendering of end.

8:3.note: שבתי rendered 'I am comforted'; 'city of truth' rendered 'holy city'.

8:10.note: Plus 'and before that time'; second שכר not rendered; 'I will let loose upon them'.

8:12.note: 'Seed shall be in peace' for 'seed of peace'.

8:13.note: והיה not rendered; final clauses transposed.

8:16.note: אשר not rendered; 'in your minds' for 'in your gates'.

8:23.note: Two 'take hold' verbs rendered once; plus 'to him'.

9:1.note: מנחתו rendered 'his offering'; 'eye of man' rendered 'revealed to the sons of men'.

9:7.note: Plural 'their blood'; Jebusite rendered 'Ebron'; plus 'shall be'.

9:12.note: 'Prisoners of hope' rendered 'of the synagogue'; free rendering 'instead of one day two'.

9:13.note: Plus 'against' twice; 'my bow' combines לי and קשת.

10:1.note: לאיש rendered 'that grows'; 'to you' for 'to them'.

11:7.note: עניי read as 'gathering'; second קראתי not rendered.

11:16.note: Plus clause 'the sick he will not heal'.

12:10.note: 'Look to me on whom they pierced'.

12:13.note: Levi clause not rendered; Shimei rendered Simeon.

13:2.note: והיה not rendered; proleptic ܒܗ ܒܝܘܡܐ; plus 'false' prophets; clauses reordered.

13:3.note: First יולדיו not rendered; ודקרהו rendered 'bind him'.

14:2.note: Ketiv/Qere תשגלנה/תשכבנה both mapped; 'half of the people' for 'remainder'.

14:4.note: 'On that day' not rendered; plus 'and half' and 'there shall be in it'.

14:6.note: והיה not rendered; יקרות read as 'cold'; Ketiv/Qere יקפאון/וקפאון both mapped.

14:7.note: 'Night nor day' inverted; second והיה not rendered.

14:8.note: והיה not rendered; יהיה not rendered.

14:18.note: Negative before עליהם not rendered ('upon them also shall be').
